content.input:
{"message": "Built and tested the Crossling landing page in /home/claude/r3/work/W009 (index.html, styles.css, app.js — no network, no external fonts/assets, opens from disk).

Direction: hobbyist-first, with the editor as the hero. The page leads with a working cross-stitch editor rather than screenshots, and handles sellers with an explicitly "undecided" commercial-terms section instead of inventing policy.

What's on the page
- Hero: "Your photo, stitched square by square." Primary CTA "Open the beta editor" (secondary: How it works). Note: free during beta, nothing uploaded.
- Live editor (the product): canvas rendered as real X stitches on aida fabric (or a symbol chart view), with Brush / Fill / Pick / Unpick tools, undo (Ctrl+Z), reset, grid toggle, keyboard editing (arrow keys + Enter, accessible label), a thread palette with live per-thread stitch counts, a 32-thread catalogue (DMC-style numbered colours) to add threads, "Swap for another thread" to recolour one thread across the whole pattern, fabric-count selector with finished-size in cm/in, and "Download chart as PNG" (symbols, 10-stitch guides, thread key).
- Two original pixel-art samples drawn in code (Sailboat with stitched sky; Pear on bare fabric) — no third-party photos or characters.
- "Your own photo…" runs entirely client-side: step-down resize to 30/40/60 stitches wide, Lab-space nearest-thread matching, capped to 8/12/16/24 threads, then loads into the editor.
- How it works (3 steps with generated SVG art), Real thread colours section with a catalogue strip, For sellers section (what's settled vs what's being decided, mailto CTA), FAQ (free beta, threads, photo privacy, commercial use, vs free converters, dark photos), final CTA, footer.

Testing (Playwright/Chromium, file://): zero console errors or page errors, no external requests; verified painting, fill, undo, swap, keyboard input, sample switching, photo import (generated PNG → 40×30, 12 threads), PNG download, beta CTA fallback, contact mailto, and mobile at 390px (no horizontal scroll, touch painting works).

Decisions to confirm / assumptions made
- Beta URL: CONFIG.BETA_URL at the top of app.js is empty; until set, "Open the beta editor" scrolls to the on-page editor and shows a toast saying the beta is moving to its permanent address. Set the constant and all three CTAs link out.
- Contact email: CONFIG.CONTACT_EMAIL defaults to hello@crossling.app (a placeholder — change it).
- Copy assumes the beta is free, has no accounts/commercial tier yet, and that the beta editor matches against a full thread catalogue; the on-page demo uses a 32-thread sample. Thread hex values are approximations of the real catalogue colours.
- Commercial use is presented as undecided, with a request for seller input, per the brief."}
